productionFixes.problem: Linux with SHELL unset selected /bin/zsh, which a minimal Ubuntu install lacks; the package smoke previously masked this with SHELL=/bin/sh.
productionFixes.fix: Use /bin/sh as the Linux fallback, retain macOS zsh and explicit SHELL, and remove the smoke override.

productionFixes.problem: A native spawn error (for example a working directory removed before dispatch) was recorded as executed with exitCode:null.
productionFixes.fix: Return a safe 503, persist a failed record, release concurrency capacity and emit no success action.

productionFixes.problem: Public-door credential caches could retain stale admission after rapid atomic credential-store writes shared mtimeMs.
productionFixes.fix: Cache revision uses successful local write generation plus file identity and nanosecond metadata; invalid credential stores fail closed and transient read failures are not memoized.

limitations: These are Linux containers on Docker Desktop, not fresh full desktop operating-system VMs; no systemd or graphical Linux desktop acceptance is claimed.
x86-64 ran under CPU emulation, not on native x86-64 hardware; timings are not native performance benchmarks.
No native Windows VM, Windows console or Windows desktop was available locally. Windows branch tests on Linux do not substitute for required Windows CI execution.

Tailscale identity states, hosted sign-in, ACLs and Funnel are deterministic fixtures in onboarding tests; no real hosted identity or tailnet enrollment occurred. A separate real vendor-binary test covers missing, daemon-stopped and logged-out states as root and an unprivileged user.
Phone UI tests use DOM clients. Physical iPhone/Android hardware, biometric authentication, push delivery and cellular/VPN transitions are outside this evidence.
Published Codex/Claude canaries validate installation and protocol compatibility without account sign-in or paid model turns.
Native Mac live desktop, iOS simulator and CI/release configuration evidence are recorded separately by the coordinating task.
Counts across runs overlap and must not be summed as unique coverage.

resourceObservations.hostContention: A separate user-started full Node24 suite ran during parts of earlier validation. It was not touched. Final full run started only after the coordinating agent confirmed it ended; a scoped Mac installed-package matrix may overlap.

hostedConnectorFailure.observed: A second newly created connector returned no JSON from registration; helper then dereferenced null client_id.
hostedConnectorFailure.suspectedCause: hostedConnectors memoization uses mtimeMs and endedVersion, which may retain an earlier connector list after rapid writes with equal modification timestamps.
hostedConnectorFailure.status: Fixed; focused Linux regression and complete combined full suite passed.
hostedConnectorFailure.confirmedCause: Rapid credential-store atomic writes shared mtimeMs, leaving cached hosted connector admission stale. Same-mtime registration reproduced404 before the fix and201 after on Mac.
hostedConnectorFailure.fix: All four public-door caches use successful local write generation plus file identity and nanosecond metadata; unreadable/corrupt stores fail closed without caching read errors.

windowsSetupFailure.cause: The setup helper returned when the pairing code arrived, then the test immediately asserted private-link guidance emitted by a later console.log. Pipe chunks are not a complete setup event.
windowsSetupFailure.classification: test stdout synchronization defect; no product failure established
windowsSetupFailure.deterministicReproduction: Temporarily delayed only the child guidance console.log by 300ms; original test failed while later normal setup lines appeared.
windowsSetupFailure.fix: Use the existing helper ready pattern for the exact guidance asserted; preserve all link, code, local route, no socket and no public Funnel assertions.
windowsSetupFailure.verification: Original delayed-output reproduction failed; normal and delayed-output targeted tests passed after test-only fix; complete combined full suite passed.
